candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Healthy gateway/order/inventory metrics and an OK checkout trace show the fault is localized to payment, not upstream services.
missing_evidence: Payment-side span/trace breakdown identifying which downstream call exceeds its deadline
Payment dependency timeout counters or upstream target of the 504s
candidates.statement: Payment service shows p95 latency of 1600ms with 9 downstream_deadline_exceeded (504) warnings, while gateway, order, and inventory remain healthy (p95 72ms, error_rate 0.0012). This isolates elevated latency and deadline failures to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of payment latency (its own downstream vs internal saturation) is not established; only the symptom is bounded.

report.explanation: Payment metrics show p95 1600ms and logs show 9 downstream_deadline_exceeded 504 warnings, while gateway, order, and inventory are healthy and the checkout trace is OK. This supports a bounded downstream-latency candidate localized to payment. The specific failing dependency is not yet identified.
